name: Utah
checked: 2026-10-09; 2026-10-10 by N10 (the reader's own requests through election/source.py)
system: Enhanced Voting (electionresults.utah.gov/results/public/...), with each county as a child jurisdiction on the same system.

results_page.label: Utah election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: results/public/api/jurisdictions/Utah (run_night.py discover) until the 2026 general appears; general11032026 by the pattern, not used until listed.

feeds.address: https://electionresults.utah.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/Utah (list: publicElectionId and date; childLocalities = 29 counties such as salt-lake-county-ut); https://electionresults.utah.gov/results/public/api/elections/Utah/<publicElectionId> (election record: lastUpdated, isOfficialResults, contestGroups, precinctsReporting, publicReportCategories, nextUpdateAt); report files under https://electionresults.utah.gov/cdn/results/<jurisdictionId>/<blobName>
feeds.updates: nextUpdateAt and lastUpdated in the record; counties upload through the night (all-mail state)
feeds.note: HTTP 200 on 2026-10-09. The contest-results endpoint itself (beyond the election record and report files) was not identified.
County summaries are listed as 'Summary Results' reports on the state record.

feeds.address: 'All Results Excel' report (Summary Results and Precinct Results sheets) from the record's publicReportCategories
feeds.note: The kit reads it for the primary.

races_in_feed: county and local (on county child jurisdictions)
local: On the same system as child jurisdictions (salt-lake-county-ut, utah-county-ut, davis-county-ut, weber-county-ut, washington-county-ut).
how_counted: Utah votes by mail; counties add ballots in batches through the night and for days after.
vote_types: Not seen (Utah votes by mail; count order is upload order).

certify.body: the Utah State Board of Canvassers
certify.rule: Convenes at noon on the fourth Monday of November (Utah Code 20A-4-306).
certify.local_rule: County canvass between the 7th and 14th day (20A-4-301).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: general11052024 (official general) and Primary06232026, kept in election_cache/replay/sources/<code>-<id>/ (kept 2026-10-10 by N10 for rehearsals)
scout_plan: Find the contest-results call the public page makes (one look in the Browser pane on the 2024 general) and rehearse on general11052024. On election night poll the Utah election record for lastUpdated and fetch contest data when it changes, then each large county's child record for local races. Enhanced Voting also runs Idaho and Georgia, so one reader serves three states.
notes: Reader (N10, 2026-10-10): enhanced_voting. check() reads the election record's lastUpdated; fetch() reads <site>/results/public/api/elections/<j>/<id>/data (statewide totals, count groups, reporting units). The per-contest county breakdown (2.5 MB a contest) is not read.
